Thank you for your interest in CSU Dominguez Hills! This articulation agreement displays lower-division course requirements specific to this major. Students are advised to meet with an academic counselor when planning to transfer to CSU Dominguez Hills and refer to the University Catalog to learn more about this major and its features. Detailed admissions requirements for transfer students are available on the CSUDH campus website. Completion of Statutory Requirements (United States History, Constitution and American Ideals) is a baccalaureate degree requirement for the California State University system and may be met prior to transfer with eligible California Community College (CCC) courses designated as US-1, US-2, and US-3. Completion of Statutory Requirements prior to transfer is most advantageous and strongly encouraged as a number of CCC courses that meet this requirement might also double-count for General Education. 

","groupId":"35f57845-6887-ef11-8474-000d3a37e3b6","position":0,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Program Notes","groupId":"80f0aa5a-3489-4581-9242-019350865996","position":1,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

The Latinx Journalism Concentration is designed to empower students to become skilled storytellers from, for, and about Latinx communities in the U.S., while upholding the highest standards of journalistic integrity and ethics. Proficiency in Spanish is emphasized, enabling students to effectively communicate with Spanish-speaking sources and audiences.


Spanish Language Courses

Students take intermediate Spanish courses (SPA 220 and SPA 221) as needed.


High School & Community College Spanish Courses: Those who have completed two, three or four years of high-school Spanish or any community college Spanish will be placed in the appropriate semester of college Spanish in consultation with a departmental advisor.


Advance Placement Exams: Students may get credit for some of these courses through the Advanced Placement Examination in either Language or Literature, and/or by transferring equivalent courses from other institutions. Students who get credit for SPA 220 and/or SPA 221 through the Advanced Placement Examination or transfer credits will, in lieu, take SPA 280.
